Furthermore, when another attempt was made with "Gabrielle (singer) birthplace," it returned a conflicting result with Bergen, Norway, which should have been immediately rectified with proper verification measures from multiple reputable sources. This indicates a missed opportunity by WebSurfer to effectively resolve ambiguity and validate the performer from credible sources, aligning with a pattern of error due to ambiguity resolution and sequential verification failure.
